item.title: 浮云一别
item.description:
江汉曾为客，相逢每醉还。浮云一别后，流水十年间。 欢笑情如旧，萧疏鬓已斑。何因不归去？淮上有秋山。– 韦应物《淮上喜会梁川故人》

investing

Oscar Wilde wrote in his story, The Picture of Dorian Gray, that nowadays people know the price of everything and the value of nothing. I guess that it is hard to know the value of things. Take the example of stock prices. IMO, there is no such thing of good stocks but over-valued or under-valued ones. the value of a stock is changing that is hard to know. You must be patient to buy at the under-valued price and be patient to hold as long as you could.
